topics.description: Minnesota is experiencing a surge in fraud allegations, particularly in the Medicaid sector. The state's efforts to create an office of inspector general and pass integrity bills aim to prevent and investigate fraud.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota fraud cases

topics.description: The Houston Independent School District (HISD) is under federal investigation for its treatment of disabled students and plans to restructure special education services.
topics.reason: Federal investigation into HISD's special education services
